title: Frances H NDE 3757
content: I was only approximately seven years old at the time of my near death experience. I don't remember the exact date it happened because I was too young. I was drowning in the ocean. I was caught in a riptide and the waves were taking me down. I was struggling and choking on water. Finally, I gave up the struggle and starting thinking that I was going to die. Then all of I sudden, it was like I 'popped' up and out of my body and my next thought was 'I'm not dead I'm alive, more alive than I had ever felt before!' I did not look back at my body or the beach. I did not travel through a tunnel. My spirit went straight to the Light. There were people in the Light. The Light and all the people in it were full of love and understanding. I was in a place where I wanted to stay. I was told many things which remain in my subconscious. At times, I can recall some of the messages I received. When it is appropriate and the time is right, I remember. I know I was told that I had to come back. I think I may have agreed to come back. I know I was told I had a purpose for coming back but I don't recall it but I know I will serve my purpose before I go back to the Light. Due to my young age at the time and my maturity level it would have been overwhelming to have recalled all the details of my experience immediately afterwards. My return to earth went like this. All of a sudden, I was in the arms of a strange man and he was lifting me out of the ocean. He set me down on the shore of the beach and asked me, 'Are you okay little girl?' and I told him yes. He then walked off and I never saw him again. I believe he was an angel who saved me and brought me back to complete my mission in life as instructed and agreed. God's will be done.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she had to come back and had a purpose/mission to complete; she does not recall the specific purpose.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning in the ocean after being caught in a riptide.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE followed by going straight to the Light (no tunnel), communication about needing to return/purpose, then sudden return to being rescued on the beach.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Returned by suddenly being in the arms of a strange man lifting her out of the ocean; she believes he was an angel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "popped' up and out of my body"; "I'm not dead I'm alive, more alive than I had ever felt before!"; "My spirit went straight to the Light."; "I know I was told that I had to come back."
